systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.country_label: SIPAO, at the Centre d'Information Policière du Togo (CIPT), the national DACORE
systems.platform: SIPAO/WAPIS, developed and implemented by INTERPOL with European Union funding; handed to national and regional authorities on 8 April 2025, the programme closing in May 2025
systems.owner: CIPT, under the Ministre de la Sécurité et de la Protection civile, who on 17 December 2024 called SIPAO a central pillar of the country's security architecture
systems.tiers: national centre in Lomé, where a criminal analysis cell (ANACRIM) was inaugurated on 17 December 2024 with equipment, software and premises paid by the programme; no remote site or unit in Togo is named

systems.owner: INTERPOL SAED project of the SIPAO programme, funded by the European Union; forensic police services
systems.tiers: fully installed in Togo, one of three pilot countries, between October and December 2024

note: No fact: for Togo the newsletter reports the analysis cell at the CIPT and the fingerprint system, and names Togo among countries on a sound path to sustaining SIPAO; it does not say what Togo's units enter, so SIPAO has no class here. The programme's closing totals are regional and not given by country: 14 countries with remote sites connected, 15 with a national budget line adopted of which 5 funded, 729,000 records by early 2025; the system is described as digitising the information in police reports.
